products.name: Rollbag R3200 Automatic Bagger
products.subtitle: Automatic Bagging System
products.description: The Rollbag R3200 automatic bagger is a high production capacity automatic poly bagging machine that can cycle at speeds of up to 80 bags per minute using Rollbag pre-opened bags on a roll. The Rollbag R3200 bagger features a compact design and is assembled with high quality off-the-shelf components. This sleek automatic bagger is designed to withstand rigorous manufacturing environments and maximize uptime.

specs.name: Speed
specs.value: up to 80 bags/minute (dependent on bag size, gauge and product)

products.photoNote: Machine reference photo. Selected options may differ.

benefits.name: operating
items: 7” color touchscreen with user-friendly interface and clear prompts
PLC with job storage, batch counters, packaging statistics, and login-in levels
Built in self-help diagnostics for troubleshooting
Compact design takes up minimal footprint in the packaging area
Standard operating height of 34.5” (4 height settings – 30.5”, 32.5”, 34.5”, 36.5” )

benefits.name: maintenance
items: Off the shelf modular components for easy replacement
Remote networking capability for improved troubleshooting
Self-diagnostics ensure quick problem solving
Quick service access to all pneumatic and electrical components
Comprehensive 5 year warranty (optional) which includes consumable parts & labor

benefits.name: setup
items: Utilizes Rollbag pre-opened bags-on-a-roll for quick bag size changes and easy set-up
Use with poly tubing (optional), for lower material costs and ability to set bag length on the fly
Adjustable height load shelf (optional) to support the bag during packaging
Interface ports to integrate counters, scales, and robotics
Ceramic heating element for fast start-up

benefits.name: safety
items: Low pressure seal bar closing
Low power consumption design (1100 Watts)
Safety cover protects access to the seal bar (when using a funnel)
CE compliant design for improved safety and troubleshooting

options.name: Foot Switch
options.description: Instead of using the start button, the cycle is activated via a foot switch. With this option the operator can have both hands free during filling of the bag.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Fixed Funnel
options.description: The funnel guides the product into the bag. The funnel is mounted above the seal bars and can be used for manual or automatic filling. It is made of stainless steel and comes in a range of sizes.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Accumulating Funnel
options.description: The stainless steel accumulating funnel is designed to accumulate parts prior to being dropped into the bag. This type of funnel is optimal when a feeder is used. The accumulating funnel allows the feeder to keep feeding parts while the bagger cycles. It also ensures that multiple parts get dropped into the bag at one time, as the funnel only opens when the bag is in position.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Seal Flattener Fingers
options.description: The seal flattener fingers go into the bag and stretch it taught prior to sealing, to minimize wrinkles in the seal area. This feature is ideal for bags that are filled with heavy products or ones that tend to pull on one side of the bag when it is filled.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Product Detect Activation Sensor
options.description: A sensor detects when the product is in the bag. When the sensor detects the product, the seal bar closes and seals the bag. The sensor is mounted underneath the seal bar and can be moved along the load shelf.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Hand Activation Sensor
options.description: This sensor detects the presence of the operator’s hand above the loading area. Once the operator drops in the product and removes their hand from the loading area then the machine automatically cycles. This sensor eliminates a step in the packaging process, as the operator does not need to press a button or activate a foot switch to cycle the bagger.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Interface Port
options.description: Allows the bagger to communicate to external devices. When integrating the bagger, it can be set to either master or slave mode. This option includes the integration cable.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: End of Roll Sensor
options.description: This sensor detects when the roll of bags is nearly empty and stops the bagger in order to allow changeover to a new roll of film.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Bag Maker Assembly
options.description: The bag maker assembly allows the R3200 bagger to use poly tubing, in addition to pre-opened bags on a roll. With poly tubing the user can change the desired bag length at the push of a button, since the bag is made on-demand. The assembly applies a bottom seal to the tubing, as well as perforates and opens the material, prior to loading. When using poly tubing the R3200 will run up to 40 bags/min (dependent on bag size, gauge, and product)
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Easy Load Bag Opener
options.description: The easy load bag opener includes several features in one. First off, this system creates a square or rectangular opening for ease of loading product into the bag. Secondly, the system physically grips the bag, in order to support heavier products. Third, the bag is stretched tight prior to sealing, to minimize wrinkles in the seal area. This option includes a sensor that detects that the film is in the fingers as well as film guides to assist in set-up. The easy load bag opener is designed for bags that are 10” or wider. This option requires the Seal Flattener Fingers to be ordered along with it.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Bag Open Sensor
options.description: This sensor detects if a bag is in the load position, open, and ready to accept product. It is primarily designed for automatic packaging applications in order to prevent product from being dumped into a bag that is not open.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Adjustable Seal Bar Opening
options.description: The adjustable seal bar opening reduces the stroke of the seal bar. A stroke that is slightly greater than the bag opening increases the packaging speed. This feature is ideal when using small bags.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Bag Holder
options.description: The bag holder is useful for getting a straight seal when packing free flowing bulk products. It can also be used as an anti-stick device to prevent light bags the bags from sticking to the sealing bar.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Static Eliminator
options.description: The static eliminator is designed to remove static electricitythat could be in the bags, The elimantor neutralizes the static charge, and is especially beneficial with thin bags.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Bag Support Outfeed Conveyor
options.description: This conveyor supports and lifts the bag during sealing, after which the sealed bags are transported to the left or right side of the bagger. This conveyor allows the operator to comfortably stand or sit in front of the bagger during packaging.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Adjustable Hole Punch
options.description: Pneumatic punch that puts a small perforated hole (flutter vent) in the bag, allowing for excess air to escape.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Print Registration
options.description: Print Registration allows the machine to run pre-printed poly tubing that requies the print to be in the same position on every bag. The machine uses a photo eye to detect the registration mark on the film and align it to the bag-making position.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Air Expeller
options.description: The air expeller is a plate with a foam pad. This device presses against the bag prior to sealing, removing excess air.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Articulating Bag Support
options.description: This option supports the bag during the sealing process. At the end of the cycle the load shelf tilts down at an angle, dispensing the bag to the next step of the packaging operation. The maximum bag length with the standard articulating bag support is 18”. This load shelf is also available with a pneumatic lifting function to settle groups of items placed into the bag.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Articulating Bag Support with Lifting Function
options.description: This option supports the bag during the sealing process. At the end of the cycle the load shelf tilts down at an angle, dispensing the bag to the next step of the packaging operation. The maximum bag length with the standard articulating bag support is 18”. This load shelf is also available with a pneumatic lifting function to settle groups of items placed into the bag.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Elevated Machine Frame
options.description: The elevated machine frame is designed for those that have bags longer than 24” and want to put a conveyor underneath it. This option is also used for tall operators that want to pack products while standing, as the loading height would be great than 36”.

options.name: Stainless Steel Frame
options.description: This option is for medical, food, or other enviroments that require a stainless steel frame for cleaning and hygiene purposes. Please note that ordering this option will require an extended lead time.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Film Perforator
options.description: The film perforator has an upper and lower assembly which creates a vertical perforation along the complete length of the bag. This perforation allows air to vent out of the bag after it has been sealed.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: 7.25” Seal Bar Pass Through
options.description: For packaging items requiring an opening larger than the standard pass-through of 6”, the R3200 can be ordered with an increased pass-through size of 7.25”. (Requires the use of Light Curtains)
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: 220V Operation
options.description: With this option the bagger will work with 220V single-phase electricity. This is designed for packaging locations that do not have 120V available, or those that want to use a lower amperage circuit in conjunction with 220V.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Remote Touchscreen Mount
options.description: Remote Touchscreen Mount

options.name: Touchscreen Cover
options.description: A clear plastic cover that protects the touchscreen from dirt, dust, and damage.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Sorting Table
options.description: A prep area placed on top of the machine, allowing the operator to prepare the products that will be packaged.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Sorting Table with frame
options.description: A prep area that is placed over the top of the machine. This provides a space for the operator to prepare the products that will be packaged.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Weigh Count Sorting Table
options.description: The Weigh Count Sorting table automatically dispenses product into the bagger once the target count has been reached. The Weigh Count Sorting Table has an accuracy of 0.003 oz (0.1 g) and a max bucket weight of 6.6 lbs (3 kg).
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Film Guides
options.description: The film guides assure that the packaging material goes straight into the bagger by keeping the film in a fixed position. This option is ideal for narrow bags and poly tubing.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Fan Folded Bag Handler
options.description: This fan folded bag handler is designed for use with large bags folded in a box. A benefit of boxed bags is reduced changeover as more bags fit in a box when compared with bags on a roll.

options.name: Videojet Dataflex Thermal Transfer Printer - 4” width, up to 300 dpi, up to 24 in/s
options.description: If you need to print large text, images, or barcodes on your bag, then a thermal transfer printer is the the right solution. Our Videojet thermal transfer printer is available with a 4” wide print head, has a print resolution of up to 300 dpi, and can print at a blazing rate of up to 24 inches per second. Additionally, printing software is available in order to make print set-up a breeze.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Sato NBO Thermal Transfer Printer – 4” width, 203 dpi, up to 12 in/s, next bag out config
options.description: If you need to print large text, images, or barcodes on your bag, then a thermal transfer printer is the the right solution. Our Videojet thermal transfer printer is available with a 4” wide print head, has a print resolution of up to 300 dpi, and can print at a blazing rate of up to 24 inches per second. Additionally, printing software is available in order to make print set-up a breeze.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Sato Batch Thermal Transfer Printer – 4” width, 203 dpi, up to 12 in/s, batch config
options.description: If you need to print large text, images, or barcodes on your bag, then a thermal transfer printer is the the right solution. Our Videojet thermal transfer printer is available with a 4” wide print head, has a print resolution of up to 300 dpi, and can print at a blazing rate of up to 24 inches per second. Additionally, printing software is available in order to make print set-up a breeze.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Label Printer Applicator
options.description: Integrated label printer applicator ties into IT network to print and apply a label directly on the outside of the bag. The printer works with labels up to 4” wide for printing and applying 4” x 6” shipping labels. It works with labels as small as 2” x 1.5” for printing and applying a barcode or other product identifying information.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Sato 305 dpi printhead upgrade
options.description: If you need to print large text, images, or barcodes on your bag, then a thermal transfer printer is the the right solution. Our Videojet thermal transfer printer is available with a 4” wide print head, has a print resolution of up to 300 dpi, and can print at a blazing rate of up to 24 inches per second. Additionally, printing software is available in order to make print set-up a breeze.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Dual Touch Start Switches
options.description: Two switches that must be touched simultaneously in order for the machine to cycle. This prevents an operator from putting their hand in the seal area while the machine is cycling.

options.name: Light Curtain
options.description: Prevents the operation of the bagger when the optical detection field is obstructed. Can also be used to trigger the start of the cycle, once the obstruction is no longer detected.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Incline Outfeed Conveyor
options.description: The incline outfeed conveyor transports bags from the bagger up to table height. With every cycle of the bagger, the conveyor indexes one step. It consists of a horizontal section where the bag is dropped, and an inclined section which has a height of approximately 35”. The height and angle of the inclined section are adjustable. The conveyor is made of stainless steel and equipped with casters. The outfeed conveyor is available in 16” conveyor width. The conveyor can be put in front of the bagger, like in the picture, or to the side of the machine.
options.applicability: Option reference; not an installed configuration.

options.name: Spare Parts Kit
options.description: This kit includes basic consumable and replacement parts fo the machine. These parts include PTFE seal bar cover, pressure rubber, and perforation knife.

options.name: Export Crate
options.description: Export Crate

products.name: Rollbag R3200 Fulfillment Bagger
products.subtitle: Automatic Bagging System
products.description: The Rollbag R3200 is an elite poly bagging fulfillment systems. This automatic bagger works with poly tubing (optional) as well as pre-made bags. The benefits of poly tubing include lower material costs as well as right-sizing of the bag to the product by changing bag length on the fly, lowering shipping costs, and less roll changeover.

specs.name: Dimensions
specs.value: 34” W x 44” D x 44” H (final dimensions dependent on exact configuration)

products.photoNote: Machine reference photo. Selected options may differ.

benefits.name: operating
items: Works with poly tubing as well as pre-opened bags on a roll
Lower material cost when using poly tubing, by making bags inline before they are filled and sealed
Load shelf outfeed conveyor for transporting bags away from the machine
Large diameter rolls and variable bag length enables machine to bag products of practically any length when using the optional bag maker assembly
Easy load bag opener squares the bag up for ease of loading and supporting heavier products
Bag open sensor detects that the bag is in position and ready to accept product
Integrated label printer applicator ties into warehouse management system to print and apply shipping label directly on the outside of the bag
7” color touchscreen with user-friendly interface and clear prompts
B&R PLC with job storage, batch counters, packaging statistics, and login-in levels

benefits.name: maintenance
items: Designed to minimize preventative maintenance costs by using off-the-shelf components
Remote networking capability for improved troubleshooting
Quick service access to all pneumatic and electrical components
Self-diagnostics ensure quick problem solving
Print head uses direct thermal printing, eliminating the need for costly printer ribbon

benefits.name: setup
items: Interface ports to integrate robotics and other feeding systems
When using poly tubing, change bag length on the fly, manually or via external integration
Store different bag length settings for quick job set-up
Stand with casters and a compact design provides portability
Quick roll change feature to facilitate easy and fast changeover

benefits.name: safety
items: Low pressure seal bar closing
CE compliant design for improved safety and troubleshooting
Readily accessible emergency stop button

benefits.name: packaging
items: Cost-savings when compared to pre-made bags
Reduction in material usage by sizing bag to the product being packaged
Reduced shipping costs due to dimensional weight pricing and minimal excess bag material
Enhanced brand association by having the right size package for the product inside
Less material changeover time due to larger size of rolls compared to pre-made bags (1.5-2x)
Less material SKUs to inventory, as only the poly tubing width matters
Less packaging material to dispose of (no boxes, sideplates, etc)
No need to print an additional color (white block) to ensure a scannable barcode (when not a white bag)
Direct thermal labels don’t require thermal transfer printer ribbon
Label printers are more reliable, simpler, and have a lower maintenance cost

This sleek automatic bagger is designed to withstand rigorous manufacturing environments and maximize uptime.

products.name: Rollbag Magnum Medical Automatic Bagger
products.subtitle: Automatic Bagging System for the Medical Industry
products.description: The Rollbag Magnum Medical automatic bagger is designed for demanding cleanroom use, and for packaging products that will be processed in an autoclave or sterilizer. The Magnum Medical features validation ports, enabling the user to reliably conduct and document the sealing parameter validation process. To ensure 100% compliant seals, pressure and temperature sensors trigger alarms and halt sealing in the event these parameters drift out of predetermined values. The Magnum Medical is a revolutionary compact form/fill/seal system that creates pouches from tubing, Tyvek® rollstock, Medical Peel Paper, barrier material, and can be used with Rollbag™ pre-opened bags on a roll. Size changes and setup are a breeze using the job storage feature and large color touchscreen.

products.subtitle: Automatic Pouching System for Medical Products
products.description: The Rollbag R3200 Med is a validatable pouching system for automatic packaging. The version of this machine will be designed to work with Tyvek/Poly rollstock with a pre-made chevron bottom seal. Dry cycle speed estimate is around 15 bags/min. The R3200 Med automates the process of labeling, filling, and sealing medical products that are packaged in Tyvek pouches with a chevron seal and need to be sterilized.
